project_info.theme: nine emotional close-up studies in a beige studio
project_info.color_palette: soft beige, navy, off-white, natural rose, monochrome black

main_subject.detail: An adult woman with medium-length dark brown hair, small gold hoops, a fine dark-blue shirt, and off-white trousers.
main_subject.style: fine-art editorial contact sheet with natural skin and restrained emotion

items: side profile with a single tear

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: large soft key from front-right, silver reflector left, weak top contour light
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: soft sculpting with a narrow horizontal highlight across selected frames

technical_specs.render_style: mixed 85mm f/1.8 closeups and 50mm half-body shot, clean grid dividers, subtle film grain

prompt.generated_prompt_string: In a soft beige studio, construct a 3x3 fine-edited photo grid of one adult woman. She wears a light dark-blue shirt and off-white trousers; use bare feet only in the seated full-body panel to retain raw texture. Light with a large soft source from front-right, a silver reflector on the left, and weak top contour light. Create nine compositions: lip close-up with fingers near the mouth; direct eye-contact close-up; black-and-white chin-rest portrait; curtain-obscured portrait; hands framing face; hair-over-one-eye study; hand-on-chin detail; half-body side-sitting pose; and cinematic side profile with a single tear. Keep all panels elegant, non-sexual, and emotionally restrained.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, sexualized pose, minor, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, mismatched grid identity
